{{Quote|They raided Fenel, a powerful, isolationist world known for its shipwrights and technologists, culminating with the Fenelar's extinction by the 6700s BBY.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Fenel''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Fenelar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. A powerful world possessing [[starshipwright]]s and [[Tech specialist|technologists]], it was eventually raided by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], resulting in the Fenelar's extinction. Fenel subsequently became a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] world and was [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Excision]].

==Description==
Fenel was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Fenel system/Legends|Fenel system]], a part of the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Mandalorian Excision was brief but overwhelming: Key Mandalorian worlds such as Fenel, Ordo, Concord Dawn, and Mandalore itself were subjected to devastating bombardment, with swathes of those worlds still desolate in Imperial times.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
[[File:Crusader.jpg|thumb|right|160px|Mandalorian Crusaders (a member pictured) caused the extinction of Fenel's native Fenelar species.]]
At some point between approximately [[7000 BBY]] and the [[6700s BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] warrior culture commenced raids against Fenel and the [[Fenelar]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Species/Legends|species]], whom, according to the text ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'' that was attributed to the later [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Tor Vizsla]], the Crusaders viewed as "unworthy and unclean."<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> The raids ultimately led to the extinction of the Fenelar by the 6700s [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Fenel itself ultimately became an important Mandalorian world alongside [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]], [[Ordo/Legends|Ordo]], and the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. All of those worlds were subjected to devastating [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] as part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[738 BBY]] operation known as the [[Mandalorian Excision]], and expansive territories on them remained barren by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later. [[Vilnau Teupt]] briefly noted Fenel's history in the keynote address "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]" at [[Brentaal Academy]]'s [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Some seven millennia ago, the Shadow Warriors came to Mandalore and cleansed surrounding space of species unworthy and unclean&mdash;the Fenelar, Tlönians, and others.|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
Fenel was the homeworld of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Fenelar<ref name="EGTW" /> species.<ref name="BHC" /> Prior to the extinction of the Fenelar, Fenel was a powerful&mdash;though isolationist&mdash;world and possessed notable [[starshipwright]]s and [[Tech specialist|technologists]]. Afterward, Fenel became an important Mandalorian world.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fenel was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fenel [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Fenel itself, in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
